purpose: Ten shareable fictional cover examples requested by owner; no actual book titles supplied

concepts.title: The Glasshouse Heir
concepts.subject: The same fictional adult male as the Black Petal reference, age28, black-and-white divided hair, refined face, white geometric collar and cropped black tailoring. A composed waist-up three-quarter portrait in the lower two-thirds, looking directly at the viewer. One silver-gloved hand rests naturally against his jacket; the other hand is out of frame.
concepts.scene: Only a few large curved greenhouse ribs fading into pale fog; one dark orchid bloom near his shoulder and a restrained crimson grass band at the foot. No giant monster. Quiet, regal and unsettling.

concepts.title: A Crown of Thorns
concepts.subject: An original fictional adult queen, age32, deep warm-brown skin, calm strong face, sculptural short natural twists, an ivory high collar above a simple black gown. One thin asymmetric black thorn circlet; no jewels or elaborate costume ornament. Large dignified bust portrait anchored in the lower half.
concepts.scene: Pale bone-white mist, the faint silhouette of one tall window, a single crimson rose petal below the portrait. Elegant authority and restrained danger. Different face and hair from the reference.

concepts.title: The Last Red Umbrella
concepts.subject: An original fictional East Asian woman detective, age40, straight chin-length black bob, thoughtful mature features, tailored charcoal coat, holding a single closed crimson umbrella by a simple silver handle. Three-quarter figure from knees up, positioned in the lower middle; hands natural and unobscured.
concepts.scene: One empty stone bridge after rain, a few strong architectural lines, flat dark water, pale distant fog. No crowds, no glowing signs, no particles. Upper quarter deep clean charcoal with no objects. Quiet suspense.

concepts.title: The Raven's Debt
concepts.subject: An original fictional adult man, age36, dark skin, short tightly curled black hair with one silver temple streak, angular thoughtful face, long black tailored coat over an ivory shirt. Three-quarter waist-up portrait in lower two-thirds. One raven perched naturally on a low stone rail beside him, not on his body.
concepts.scene: A pale disc of late moonlight behind the shoulder and one distant manor silhouette, mostly dark charcoal negative space. A small deep-red lining of his coat provides the only warm accent. No flocks or scattered feathers.

concepts.title: Where the Petals Sleep
concepts.subject: An object-led cover with no people: one sculptural translucent black orchid bloom opening around a small pearl-white luminous hollow, on a slender curved silver-dark stem. Petals have the restrained refined rendering of the reference but much simpler venation. The flower occupies the central and lower-middle area.
concepts.scene: An expansive bone-white background with a very faint pale-gray gradient, one thin crimson root curving across the bottom. A single elegant botanical object, beautiful, eerie, and easy to read; no pattern filling the background.

concepts.title: A Vow Beneath Winter
concepts.subject: Two original fictional adults, a woman age30 with olive skin and long dark loose hair in a simple ivory gown, and a man age33 with warm-brown skin and short dark curls in black formal tailoring. They face each other in profile, close but not kissing, as waist-up figures in the lower two-thirds. One visible pair of hands gently touches near waist level, anatomically clear; other hands outside frame.
concepts.scene: A single broad frost-clouded greenhouse arch and pale winter mist. One tiny crimson ribbon joining the two restrained costumes. Faces are the focus. No ornamental vines, no snowfall particles, no extra figures.

concepts.title: The Keeper of Hollow Rooms
concepts.subject: An original fictional adult woman, age48, luminous pale skin, mature composed face, long sleek silver hair tucked over one shoulder, structured black high-collar coat with a single silver clasp. A dignified waist-up portrait, lower two-thirds. She holds one simple antique silver key at chest level, anatomically clear fingers.
concepts.scene: One partially visible rectangular doorway behind her dissolves into pale emptiness. Restrained soft shadows and a thin deep-crimson inner door edge. No corridors full of doors or ornamental wallpaper. Refined uncanny stillness.

concepts.title: The Sea Keeps Names
concepts.subject: An original fictional adult man, age42, weathered light-brown skin, short dark beard and wind-combed dark hair, black seafarer's coat with a simple ivory collar. A thoughtful head-and-shoulders portrait anchored lower-left, clearly visible facial features and no tiny decorative marks.
concepts.scene: A broad quiet dark ocean horizon and a distant single pale curling wave that subtly resembles an orchid petal. Deep blue-black, silver, bone white; one restrained wine-red collar lining. Upper quarter calm near-black sky. No ships, storm spray, tentacle clutter or scattered lights.

concepts.title: The Orchard of Lost Letters
concepts.subject: An original fictional adult woman, age29, lightly freckled warm skin, loosely pinned auburn hair, contemplative face, a plain dark tailored riding jacket and soft ivory blouse. Waist-up portrait in lower two-thirds, holding a single closed ivory envelope without any writing or seal text. Her hands are clear and natural.
concepts.scene: One leafless black branch arcs along the side without crossing the face, one distant orchard ridge dissolves into warm bone-white fog. Restrained copper hair and deep crimson cuff lining, no densely rendered leaves or paper storm. Intimate, quiet, wistful.

concepts.title: The Silver Door
concepts.subject: An architectural cover with no people: one tall elegant silver-edged black door, slightly open, standing alone above two broad stone steps. A narrow luminous bone-white opening is the central focal point. One small crimson orchid grows at the threshold.
concepts.scene: A spacious deep charcoal void with restrained soft floor shadows. No palace, no carved ornament, no forest or multiple doors. Door occupies middle-to-lower portion with quiet darkness above. Refined graphic shapes and a few exquisite material highlights.
